caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, viewed from an angle that reveals both the front and left side. The chest has a grayish-blue base color overall and features elaborate decorative patterns. The front panel displays a rectangular framed section adorned with swirling floral and vine motifs in shades of yellow, red, muted green, and white, with two large yellowish-orange flowers being predominant on either side. The frame around this central decoration contains a series of flowing zigzag patterns in white and red against the grayish background. The left panel of the chest is also decorated, showing a stylized tree or plant with thin white branches and small red details, bordered by a similar white and red wavy pattern. The edges and corners of the chest have worn, slightly faded outlines, suggesting aged wood, and the background of the image is an uncolored or light beige plain surface.
title: Painted Guilford Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
